## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Related issue

Link the discussion or issue. Explain if none is needed.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their outcomes. Note anything not tested.

## UI evidence

For visual changes, add light/dark screenshots using synthetic data.

## Compatibility and provenance

Describe changes to calculations, stored data, APIs or dependencies, if any.
Identify the source and license of any added code, text or dataset.

- [ ] No keys, private user data or unapproved Atlas material are included.
- [ ] Substantial features were discussed before implementation.
- [ ] The change follows CONTRIBUTING.md and the applicable license scope.
